samir: Originating RC rc-2026-04-01a (tag rc-a01). Built and pushed: registry:redwood/inference:rc-a01. Requesting ops pin + KV warm. Proposed quiet window 18:30-19:30 UTC. Quick canary plan in thread.

deploy-bot: [CI] RC created rc-a01 (build 1042). Artifacts uploaded to s3://ci/rc-1042/. KV-warm queued (kv-1042).

zoe: Staging smoke passed. Minor eval variance on edge prompts but within tolerance. Model pin remains v2.4.7-rc0 (quant=q4f16).

ops-sheriff: I'll be primary for the quiet window and at console by 18:20 UTC. Deadman-latch set to auto-cut if errors >1% for 3m or GPU OOM.

samir: Canary plan: 0.5% for 10m -> 5% for 15m -> 25% for 20m -> promote if green. Thresholds: p95 < 170ms, errors < 0.6%. Watch token-cost and model memory.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary 0.5% -> rc-a01 at 2026-04-01T18:30:05Z. Initial metrics: p95=140ms, errors=0.05%

zoe: Holding 10m. No anomalies so far. Proceed to 5%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% complete at 2026-04-01T18:41:22Z. Monitoring continues.

samir: No infra issues. Proceed to 25% after 15m. If anything spikes, use rollback snippet pinned in runbook.

release-coordinator: Notifying early adopters and updating release notes draft. Will send final announce on full promote.

ops-sheriff: All clear. Approving full promote after 25% hold if metrics stable.

(threads end)
